observations.epoc_eikonir_send: Device-dependent: a second 5mx transfers quickly, while the first device repeatedly stalls or disconnects, including near 95%.
observations.irobex: Palm Beam send completed with EudoraWeb_2.1.prc on a Palm IIIc running Palm OS 4.1.

notes.nl: Dit exemplaar is betrouwbaar op 9600 bit/s. Bij 57k6 en 115k2 valt de link na de snelheidswissel stil.
notes.en: This unit is reliable at 9600 bit/s. At 57.6k and 115.2k the link stalls after changing speed.

adapters.name: Ming Yuan MY018 TTL-SIR
adapters.required_for_dynamic_speed: Modified A/B/C selectors, board-referenced pulldowns, 2N3904 low-side switch and opt-in driver/helper

notes.nl: Met aangepaste A/B/C-bedrading en transistorschakeling: 57k6 getest voor PPP op Palm IIIc en Psion 5mx, en Beam naar Palm. 19k2 gedeeltelijk getest; 38k4 nog niet. 115k2 experimenteel: verbindingen mislukten in de tests. Dit is geen algemene IrDA-grens. EPOC en terminaltransfers met deze module nog niet opnieuw geverifieerd.
notes.en: With modified A/B/C wiring and transistor switch: 57.6k tested for PPP on Palm IIIc and Psion 5mx, and Beam to Palm. 19.2k partially tested; 38.4k untested. 115.2k experimental: test connections failed. This is not a general IrDA limit. EPOC and terminal transfers have not been reverified on this module.

notes.nl: Experimenteel. Het geteste bord was elektrisch defect en produceerde geen TXIR-pulsen.
notes.en: Experimental. The tested board was electrically defective and produced no TXIR pulses.
